description: Erection of 10 x 2 bedroom, 8 x 3 bedroom and 1 x 4 bedroom flats (19 residential flats) additional floorspace for financial (A2) and Business (B1) use on ground floor and 3 storeys on Western Corner and associated parking to site. (Brentford Lock, West Bank)
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason For Approval

The proposed development would enhance the character of the Grand Union Canal Conservation Area and provides a satisfactory mix of accommodation and employment uses. This is in accordance with Policies ENV.B.1.1 (New development), ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation areas) and IMP.2.1 (Regeneration of Brentford Town Centre and Riverside) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - 2. The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension hereby permitted is used).

(Reason.  To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission)
Condition : 4 - 3. No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

(Reason.  In order that the Council may be satisfied as to the details of the development in the interests of the visual amenity of the area and to satisfy the requirements of policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development)
Condition : 5 - 4. No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include (proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (eg drainage power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc);

Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme).

(Reason.  To ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and improve the visual amenities of the locality in accordance with policy ENV.B.1.1 New development.)
Condition : 6 - 5. All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details. The works shall be carried out prior to occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with a programme agreed with the Local Planning Authority

Reason: In the interest of the visual amenities of the area and to protect / conserve the natural features and character of the area.
Condition : 7 - 6. No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:30am to 5:30pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

(Reason.   In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties)
Condition : 8 - 7.Deliveries to any commercial premises once constructed shall only be made to or despatched from the site between the hours of 7:00am to 6:30pm.
	
Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties and in the interest of road safety
Condition : 9 - 8. No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby by permitted by means of horizontal division without prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: In order not to prejudice the Council's standards for provision of car parking spaces and service facilities
Condition : 10 - 9. No fans, louvers, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To protect the visual amenities of the area
Condition : 11 - 10. Before the development is commenced the details of vehicular access to and within the car parks, including location, type and operation to and within the car park; circulation space; disabled parking spaces; lighting; CCTV; and hard landscaping of the rear parks shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved scheme and permanently retained thereafter.

Reason: In the interests of Highway Safety and to ensure a satisfactory environment for car users.
Condition : 12 - 11. Before the development is occupied, details of cycle access to, and within, and details of cycle parking in the car parks and the total number of cycle parking spaces for the whole development for the public and residents shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority and the spaces shown on any of the drawings shall be available for use before the first occupation of any part of the development and permanently maintained and retained thereafter.

Reason: In order to provide satisfactory and safe pedestrian access in the car parks and to the development. 
Condition : 13 - 12. Before the development is occupied, a scheme indicating pedestrian access (including access for the disabled) from car park to the development and residential buildings and details of pedestrian access within the car parks by means of designated pedestrian walkways, where necessary, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved scheme.
Reason: To ensure satisfactory appearance of the site and improve the visual amenities of the locality to maintain structural integrity and the stability of the flood defences and river wall. 
Condition : 14 - 13. Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to all lifts, residential buildings and all other commercial spaces, and details of all ramps and disabled toilets have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.
(Reason.  To provide satisfactory access for people with disabilities. 
Condition : 15 - 
14. The access doorway to the ground level commercial units shall have a minimum clear width of 1800mm for double doors and 900 for single width doors, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Reason.  To provide satisfactory access for people with disabilities
Condition : 16 - The balconies shall not be installed until detailed drawings of the proposed balconies have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local Planning Authority.
Condition : 17 - 15. The parking, loading and turning spaces shown on the approved plans shall be constructed and available for use before the first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.
Reason: In order to prevent obstruction and inconvenience to users of the adjoining highway and in the interest of road safety
Condition : 18 - 16. There shall be no more than 23 car parking spaces used in connection with the site for residential use and the remainder for commercial and public use.
Reason: To limit the maximum number of cars on the site, in the interest of controlling traffic congestion, therefore improving road safety and encouraging the use of public transport.
Condition : 19 - 17. Before development commences details of facilities for the loading, unloading and turning of vehicles clear of the public highway shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and implemented in strict accordance with the approved details before first occupation of any part of the development.
Reason To ensure that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or conditions of general safety along the adjoining highway
Condition : 20 - 18. The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.
(Reason.  To safeguard the amenities of the area)
Condition : 21 - 19. No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the development hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: In order that the Local Planning Authority may be able to control any future change which may prejudice existing or future occupiers of the site.
Condition : 22 - 20. No spoils or materials shall be deposited or stored on that part of the site lying within the area of land liable to flood. 
Reason: To prevent the increased risk of flooding due to impedance of flood flows and reduction of flood storage capacity
Condition : 23 - 21. The commercial units shall be used for business purposes in line with Class B1/A2 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes (Amendment)) Order 2005 and for not other purposes whatsoever.
Reason: In order to maintain business floor space in this mixed use development
Condition : 24 - 22. The business (class B1) floor space hereby permitted shall not be used for the servicing, valeting or repair of motor vehicles.
Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of the adjoining residential occupiers and to maintain business floor space in this mixed use development
Condition : 25 - Informatives
Under the Thames River (Prevention of Floods) Act 1879/1962, the statutory tidal flood defence level which is 5.94 above Ordnance Datum Newlym must be maintained at all times with temporary works if necessary.
The prior written consent of the Environment Agency is required for any proposed works or structures likely to affect structural integrity of the flood defences; for any discharge of sewage or trade effluence into controlled waters; for discharge of sewage or trade effluence from buildings or fixed plant into or onto ground or into waters which are not controlled waters; for de-watering from any excavation or development to a surface watercourse.
The developer is required to inform the Environment Agency of any intention to dewater any quarry or excavation. An abstraction licence will normally be required for the abstraction of water from any inland water or underground strata.
The applicant's attention is drawn to the Environment Agency's advice regarding land drainage, recreation, water resources, flood defence, biology, groundwater protection, waste regulation, and surface water pollution set out their letter dated 18 November 1999.
